Definition: from the same as G3670; acknowledgment:--con- (pro-)fession, professed.
BiblicalUsage: homología is the word for confession, profession. I meet it 6 times across the Bible, and 2 Corinthians is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe homología matters because confession is not informing God of what He already knows — it is agreeing with Him. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
